name: Obsidian Voice Capture
author: alarawms
description: Press SUPER+SHIFT+V (or click the bar icon) to record; press again to stop. Transcribes locally with Omarchy's voxtype engine and files the note straight into your Obsidian vault: appended to today's daily note and saved as its own note in Inbox/.

barWidget.description: Microphone icon: click to start/stop a voice capture that gets transcribed and filed into your Obsidian vault.

schema.label: Show the microphone icon while idle
